newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Nelco in S$17 mln Singapore plant expansion.
newsitem.headline: Nelco in S$17 mln Singapore plant expansion.

text.p: Nelco Products Pte Ltd, part of U.S.-based Park Electrochemical Corp, said on Friday it had invested Singapore $17 million to expand its plant in Singapore.
The investment goes towards doubling the capacity of the Singapore plant, which makes epoxy multi-layer laminates for printed circuit boards, it said in a statement.
Nelco's investments in Singapore have exceeded S$45 million and its Singapore plant its largest outside the United States.
Nelco expects to identify its next investment area in the Pacific Rim in 1998, Michael Hehl, managing director of Nelco Singapore Pte Ltd said in the statement.
